CRITICAL_FINDING_shape_correction.problem: L3 as implemented used T_Delta = the bare (Pinf,P0,P1) triangle (3 vertices) as the base copy transformed by each g_i. This is WRONG for Delta(a,b,c) as a ROTATION (von Dyck) group: Delta(a,b,c) contains no reflections, so a single triangle cannot be its own fundamental domain -- the true fundamental domain is a KITE (quadrilateral) formed by the triangle and its mirror image across one side.
CRITICAL_FINDING_shape_correction.how_found: Cloned the actual Magma calculation engine (scratchpad/BelyiEngine_repo, HEAD 0cd768d5762aedb61618020d331da77634503987 -- survey_v1 had identified this repo but had not yet cloned/read it; done this ben specifically to check this point per the coordinator's 'KMSV/engine source wins on conflict' instruction) and read Code/triangle.m intrinsic FundamentalDomain (L503-565).
CRITICAL_FINDING_shape_correction.verbatim_engine_confirmation: L96 comment: '// fundamental domain split up the two half-triangles'; L511 docstring: 'fundamental domain for Delta(a,b,c) in a list: [z_a, z_c, z_b, z_c^*]' -- a 4-vertex kite, z_c^* being the mirror of z_c.
CRITICAL_FINDING_shape_correction.exact_formula_extracted_L546_552: l := (cos(pi/a)cos(pi/b)+cos(pi/c)) / (sin(pi/a)sin(pi/b));  t := l + sqrt(l^2-1);  x := (t^2-1) / (2*(cot(pi/a)+t*cot(pi/b)));  y := sqrt(csc(pi/a)^2 - (x-cot(pi/a))^2);  V := [i, x+y*i, t*i, -x+y*i]  (vertices z_a=i, z_c=x+y*i, z_b=t*i, z_c*=-x+y*i, in this cyclic order).
CRITICAL_FINDING_shape_correction.downstream_consequence: L1's generator matrices (delta_0/delta_1/delta_inf) and G-2 gate results are UNAFFECTED and remain valid (they only depend on the abstract group presentation, not the FD shape). L3's g_i coset matrices (BFS) are also unaffected (same reasoning). Only the BASE POLYGON transformed by each g_i needs to change from the 3-vertex triangle to the 4-vertex kite V above. This is a straightforward, well-specified correction for ben2 -- not a redesign.
